artworks.title: Seated Nude with Her Arm Resting on Her Leg (Femme nue assise, le bras appuyé sur la jambe)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure seated with one leg crossed over the other, leaning their head on their hand, with an elbow resting on their knee and gazing slightly downward. The facial features are softly rendered, focusing on the curvature of the nose and the outline of the lips. The person has short hair falling naturally around their head. There is no visible clothing, and the background is shaded and textured, possibly suggesting an indoor setting with a wall or curtain behind them. Abstract lines and shading around the figure enhance the engraved appearance of the artwork.

artworks.title: Seated Nude with Her Arm Resting on Her Leg (Femme nue assise, le bras appuyé sur la jambe)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a nude figure from the knees up, seated with one leg crossed over the other. The person's face is turned slightly to the side, with one hand resting against their cheek. Their hair is short and textured, and they are not wearing any clothing. There are no visible objects around them, and the background features shaded areas with cross-hatched textures resembling a wall. In the bottom right corner, there is a signature that reads "A. Besnard."

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Landscape
artworks.description: The image displays an intricately carved frame enclosing a landscape scene. The view is centered on the scene within the frame. The landscape includes buildings and distant hills or trees. The frame and scene are detailed with fine lines and hatching to show texture and depth. The frame is adorned with swirling patterns, scrolls, and a shell motif at the top center. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing the details of the frame and scene. The frame occupies most of the space, directing attention to the central circular landscape, creating a sense of a distant world captured within the design.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Bust
artworks.description: The image shows a bust sculpture of a human figure within an ornate niche. The bust features a figure with long hair, draped in a garment covering the shoulders, depicted in a monochrome engraving style. The niche surrounding the bust is decorated with carved patterns, including scroll-like motifs at the top and curved lines framing the figure. The presentation gives the sculpture a classical appearance and a sense of importance or reverence. Detailed hatching in the engraving adds depth and shading, enhancing the three-dimensionality of the sculpture and its niche.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with Three Shields, Two with Figures
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural detail. The image showcases an intricately designed architectural pediment with an empty heraldic shield at its center. The structure is embellished with acanthus leaves, volutes, and carved keystones that highlight the archway below. The precision of the lines gives texture to the surface, with a focus on symmetry and balance. Ornamental touches such as floral motifs and decorative reliefs enhance the grandeur and sophistication of the design.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with Bust and Two Lamps
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural cartouche featuring a bust. The drawing depicts a classical decorative element, comprised of an embellished frame or shield. Within the center of the cartouche is an engraved depiction of a bust, set against a background with subtle details. The cartouche is surrounded by decorative scrollwork and intricately carved embellishments, showcasing a high level of craftsmanship. The use of shading and line work details suggest depth and texture throughout the design.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with Three Shields
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural element. The drawing features intricate Baroque-style designs with elaborate scrolls and volutes. The central part of the design includes an empty shield or cartouche surrounded by curved moldings and carvings. The shading and line work suggest a sense of depth.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Drape with Fruit
artworks.description: The image shows a large decorative tapestry with a fruit motif, hung against an ornate architectural background. The color scheme is mainly beige and brown. The tapestry is in the center, flanked by acanthus leaves, and framed by a balustrade below. Festoon-like garlands hang from the top corners towards the center.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Vase
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural ornament. The image includes a detailed depiction of a decorative architectural element showcasing intricate scrollwork and leaf patterns. The central figure resembles an ornate volute, accompanied by symmetrical curving lines and foliage motifs. The drawing demonstrates a high level of craftsmanship and attention to decorative detail, typical of classical architectural drawings.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Bird
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural ornament. It features an eagle, decorative floral elements, and a shield. The central eagle has outstretched wings and is flanked by two identical baskets or urns with intricate floral arrangements. Above the eagle, there are two wreaths or garlands, and the lower section includes a shield surrounded by ornate scrollwork. The piece is detailed with shading and line work, typical of classic decorative styles in architectural designs.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with a Figure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural structure. The structure features classical design elements, including an ornate pediment at the top, supported by elegant curvilinear columns with decorative volutes. The central area contains an emblem or cartouche bordered by intricate scrollwork, which holds a small depiction of a figure in its center. Below the emblem, there is an arch-like form with detailed linear shading that adds depth. The embellishments suggest a sense of grandeur and precision typical of classical or baroque architectural drawings. The balance of the composition and the fineness of the ink work highlight the skill in capturing the three-dimensionality and ornate detailing of classical architecture.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with Three Shields
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design. The image features a detailed illustration of a decorative, baroque-style cartouche with an empty central oval space, surrounded by elaborate swirling acanthus leaves and scrollwork. The lines are intricately drawn, highlighting the elegant curves and intricate detail of the ornamentation. The lower part of the image shows a rectangular panel with parallel lines, suggesting a base or an architectural frieze. The composition showcases the complexity and intricacy typical of classical decorative art.

artworks.title: Architectural Motif with Fruit in a Vase
artworks.description: The image features a shield or plaque with a central urn surrounded by ornate carvings. The color scheme is beige and brown, with varying shades highlighting the details. The urn is in the center, with decorative scrolls on either side, a draped pattern above, and a textured lower section resembling carved stone.

artworks.title: View of Rome
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with various buildings, including domed structures in the distance. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, capturing the sprawling architecture leading up to the prominent domes. The skyline displays a large dome, likely a cathedral or historical building. The buildings closest to the viewer have terracotta-tiled roofs, creating a detailed tapestry. The image is in monochromatic sepia tones, emphasizing the architectural details. The color palette is warm and earthy.

artworks.title: Two Satyrs in a Forest
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures seated outdoors. On the left is a nude human with short hair. On the right is a mythological creature resembling a satyr, with human features from the waist up and goat features below. Both are seated in a lush, foliage-filled setting with a large tree trunk in the background.

artworks.title: Jacob Balthazar Schitz
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a person in profile view, facing right. The individual has wavy, shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features. They are wearing a garment with a high collar and buttons. The background has intricate cross-hatching patterns. Below the figure, text reads "IACOB BALTH: SCHITZ" followed by "Año 1670".

artworks.title: Battling Tritons
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical battle scene among sea creatures. Two dominant figures stand amidst tumultuous waves. Each possesses the body of a human with strong, muscular features, but also the tail of a fish, characteristic of merfolk. One figure, on the left, is captured mid-action with a weapon raised above its head. The figure on the right holds a shield with a fierce expression, ready for defense as water splashes around them. To the right, another similar creature looks on. The scene is set against a backdrop of tall, waving reeds and a few birds can be seen flying above. The detailed linework creates a sense of movement and intensity within the composition.

artworks.title: Study of a Jockey
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person shown from the side, with their upper body visible down to waist level. The individual is seated, slightly leaning forward, with their shoulders hunched and head inclined forward. Their facial features are drawn in profile, with a sharp nose and a subtle chin line; the shadow of a prominent brow and shaded eye area conveys a contemplative posture. They are wearing a cap that covers the person’s hair and a jacket with a raised collar, accompanied by folds indicating material texture. The background is plain with no additional objects or elements, emphasizing the focus on the figure's posture and clothing. The artist's signature, "Degas," is visible in red in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Two Studies of a Jockey
artworks.medium: black chalk, charcoal, and pastel on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two men at approximately half-body length, seated side by side and facing away from each other. The man on the left is leaning forward, with his head and shoulders turned towards his left. He has a beard, a cap, a long-sleeved shirt with rolled-up sleeves, light-colored pants, and shoes. The man on the right is sitting upright, also with a cap and a beard, and dressed in a similar style. They appear to be holding onto an object between them. The background is a simple, sketch-like surface with minimal details.

artworks.title: Study of a Jockey (M. de Broutelles)
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image is a charcoal drawing of two profiles of a man from the shoulders up. The man is shown leaning forward slightly, with his head angled downwards. He has a beard, mustache, downward-sloping nose, and hair covered by a cap. He wears a simple shirt or jacket. The background is plain, emphasizing the man's sketches on light-colored paper.

artworks.title: Le Hibou (The Owl)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and saltground, with burnishing and roulette in black and brown ink on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection, Gift in Honor of the Fiftieth Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This drawing contains an allegorical and surreal scene, featuring a central framed image of an owl next to an open book on a pedestal. The words "PAUCA PAUCIS" are below the central image. Surrounding this central scene are various interconnected vignettes, including a cityscape, ships' masts, ghostly figures in the sky, and a figure sitting with a feather pen amidst swirling mist and smoke. The drawing is detailed and intricate, blending fantastical and real elements.

artworks.title: Klosterhof in Franken (Franconian Cloister)
artworks.description: The image shows an interior perspective looking out into a courtyard with a checkered floor leading to two large arched openings. Two figures stand in the courtyard with their backs turned. Trees and architectural elements can be seen beyond the arches. The scene is portrayed in an etching or engraving style with fine line work defining the architecture and natural elements. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown to create depth. Figures inside the building are engaged in conversation or activity, adding life to the structured environment.

artworks.title: Ruine Frauenkirch mit dem Grabmale der Genoveva und des Pfalzgrafen Siegfried (Ruins of the Church of Our Lady with the Tombs of Genevieve and Count Siegfried)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ruined church interior. The image shows a dilapidated sanctuary with large gothic arches and columns. The roof is partially missing, allowing the view of the sky and some foliage through the remaining structure. In the center-right, there is an altar-like structure or tomb with sculptural elements. The stone walls are worn with age, and vegetation can be seen encroaching upon the building. Natural light filtering in through the openings highlights the details of the stonework.

artworks.title: A Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Jonas Suyderhoff after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This painting depicts a hunt with animals and riders. The scene shows a confrontation between humans on horseback and various wild animals like lions and a leopard. A lion is depicted in the center apparently pouncing on a figure beneath. The horses react to the chaos, and the painting includes details of armor and clothing textures. The image is dynamic and intense, conveying the tension and action of the scene in a style reminiscent of Peter Paul Rubens.
